experiment: DCF-24 frozen DCF-23 message-passing correction in the high-width regime
verification: DCF-14 run_instance: reference = einsum VE under the generating model (max union 22), accepted only if an independent exact path agrees within 1e-8; unverifiable instances are dropped
models: DCF-23 mp_bp seeds 0,1,2 loaded frozen from dcf23_message_passing/models (digests in that directory's PRE_PREDICT_SHA256); no retraining or recalibration
costs: exact = counted ops of the cheapest exact operator (symbolic); BP = 50-iteration loopy BP counted ops; model path = BP ops + model multiply-accumulates (different units, summed as stated)

gates.H1: acting on the frozen mp_bp posterior beats acting on BP in expected utility (bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean paired difference > 0) for at least 2 of 3 seeds
gates.H2: on instances where exact ops exceed BP ops plus model MACs (at least 20 such instances), the same comparison passes for at least 2 of 3 seeds
gates.H3: at both caps, 'exact if its ops fit the cap, else mp_bp' beats 'exact if it fits, else BP' in expected utility (bootstrap lower bound > 0) for at least 2 of 3 seeds
